_comment: SSS house system (HouseTypeWanted 11, menu 33388; src/core/sss sssHouseCusps, tests/calcVariants.test.ts skips while the output is absent). One run per variant, each into golden/jhora-sss-houses/<variant>/ with capture.py --ini overrides: middle (--ini Siddhanta=1 --ini HouseTypeWanted=11 --ini HouseCuspsInMiddle=1); start (--ini Siddhanta=1 --ini HouseTypeWanted=11 --ini HouseCuspsInMiddle=0); sss-ayanamsa (--ini Siddhanta=1 --ini HouseTypeWanted=11 --ini UserSelectedAyanamsa=18). Restore the copy's jhcore/jhora.ini (golden/jhora-defaults.ini) afterwards - JHora saves its options on exit (Siddhanta=0, HouseTypeWanted=1, HouseCuspsInMiddle=1, UserSelectedAyanamsa=17).
